title: Tierra y derechos
goal: Read how the 1989 ILO Convention 169 gave Indigenous movements a key legal tool for land rights, alongside Nicaragua's 1987 Atlantic Coast autonomous regions and Colombia's resguardo system.

items: State what ILO Convention 169 recognized in 1989.
Explain why it became so widely cited by Indigenous movements.
Use en la medida en que to express a proportional condition.
I can state what ILO Convention 169 recognized in 1989.
I can explain why it became so widely cited by Indigenous movements.
I can describe what Nicaragua's 1987 statute created.
I can explain what a Colombian "resguardo" is.
I can use en la medida en que to express a proportional condition.
